name: Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (CHF)
oneLiner: CHFSAFO is Spiko's CHF UCITS fund share, using Amundi-managed overnight total-return swaps and KYC-gated redemption at NAV.
collateral: CHF accumulation share class FR0014015LG6 of Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund. Physical securities are hedged through portfolio-wide total-return swaps, with a possible unswapped money-market UCITS sleeve. CACEIS Bank is depositary; counterparty default can expose underlying security and currency risks.
pegMechanism: CHF-denominated NAV-accreting UCITS share class with KYC-gated subscriptions and redemptions at daily fund NAV through Spiko. Orders are centralized by 15:00 Paris time; ordinary redemption settles D+1, subject to the currency market being open. The management company may cap redemptions when net requests reach 25% of sub-fund net assets; the trigger is the same for all share classes, with at most 20 valuation days of capping over three months. Unexecuted orders carry over without priority; suspension and swing pricing can also limit or delay exit.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact CHF share FR0014015LG6 in fund 59c2c924-ebf8-492d-a4b0-72d72ebf61e6 is proportional UCITS portfolio ownership with portfolio-wide total-return swaps, possible unswapped money-market UCITS and legal separation. The issuer API and September prospectus identify eight native registers. The 14 October inventory contains 107 signed equity, swap and cash rows; negative derivative values are not normalized to positive reserve weights. Fresh Ethereum block 26197328 confirms five decimals and 6009355.28609 shares; finalized Solana slot 457209716 confirms five decimals and zero supply. These observations support ucits-trs-fund, not complete current NAV, collateral, netting or default-recovery reconciliation.
